exposure: lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) type of delivery
cohort: The study included 220 lactating women residing in urban slums and rural areas of Ananthapuramu district, South India.
finding: The overall prevalence of mental health issues in lactating women was 23.6% in rural areas and 27.3% in urban slums.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) type of delivery was a predictor for poor mental health status among lactating women from rural backgrounds.
